### Protected by His Presence
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-january-30-2024.html
Passage: Genesis 39:2
Points:
- Earthly life offers no trouble-free circumstances, and searching for perfection will bring continual disappointment.
- Joseph's sudden descent into slavery shows that God allows His people to walk through severe valleys.
- God does not always protect believers from trials, but protects them in their trials with His presence.
- Knowing the Lord is present gives believers purpose and stability wherever they are placed.

### I Will Not Lie with You
Author: Marshall Segal
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/i-will-not-lie-with-you
Passage: Genesis 39:8-9
Points:
- Overcoming sexual temptation requires deep, Spirit-wrought convictions rather than external boundaries alone.
- Joseph treasured relational trust and recognized that authority is given to serve rather than exploit others.
- Honoring the sacred covenant of marriage helped Joseph see adultery as deeply repulsive.
- Cherishing God as supreme and deeply satisfying provides the power to refuse persistent temptation.
